name: BsdDbShelf
signatures: BsdDbShelf(dict, protocol=None, writeback=False, keyencoding='utf-8', *, serializer=None, deserializer=None)
doc:
Shelf implementation using the "BSD" db interface.

This adds methods first(), next(), previous(), last() and
set_location() that have no counterpart in [g]dbm databases.

The actual database must be opened using one of the "bsddb"
modules "open" routines (i.e. bsddb.hashopen, bsddb.btopen or
bsddb.rnopen) and passed to the constructor.

See the module's __doc__ string for an overview of the interface.

changed.text: Added the serializer and deserializer parameters.

name: DbfilenameShelf
signatures: DbfilenameShelf(filename, flag='c', protocol=None, writeback=False, *, serializer=None, deserializer=None)
doc:
Shelf implementation using the "dbm" generic dbm interface.

This is initialized with the filename for the dbm database.
See the module's __doc__ string for an overview of the interface.

changed.text: Added the serializer and deserializer parameters.

name: open
signatures: open(filename, flag='c', protocol=None, writeback=False, *, serializer=None, deserializer=None)
doc:
Open a persistent dictionary for reading and writing.

The filename parameter is the base filename for the underlying
database.  As a side-effect, an extension may be added to the
filename and more than one file may be created.  The optional flag
parameter has the same interpretation as the flag parameter of
dbm.open(). The optional protocol parameter specifies the
version of the pickle protocol.

See the module's __doc__ string for an overview of the interface.

changed.text: pickle.DEFAULT_PROTOCOL is now used as the default pickle protocol.
Accepts custom serializer and deserializer functions in place of pickle.dumps() and pickle.loads().

name: Shelf
signatures: Shelf(dict, protocol=None, writeback=False, keyencoding='utf-8', *, serializer=None, deserializer=None)
doc:
Base class for shelf implementations.

This is initialized with a dictionary-like object.
See the module's __doc__ string for an overview of the interface.

changed.text: Added the keyencoding parameter; previously, keys were always encoded in UTF-8.
pickle.DEFAULT_PROTOCOL is now used as the default pickle protocol.
Added the serializer and deserializer parameters.

name: close
doc: Synchronize and close the persistent dict object. Operations on a closed shelf will fail with a ValueError.

name: reorganize
doc: Calls sync() and attempts to shrink space used on disk by removing empty space resulting from deletions.

name: sync
doc: Write back all entries in the cache if the shelf was opened with writeback set to True. Also empty the cache and synchronize the persistent dictionary on disk, if feasible. This is called automatically when reorganize() is called or the shelf is closed with close().

name: ShelveError
doc: Exception raised when one of the arguments deserializer and serializer is missing in the open(), Shelf, BsdDbShelf and DbfilenameShelf.
